items.question: What is the maximum dowry limit for UAE nationals under the UAE Islamic marriage contract rules?
items.gold: AED 50,000 is the maximum dowry limit for UAE nationals.
items.fact: Maximum dowry for UAE nationals is AED 50,000.

items.question: How many wives may a Muslim man have under UAE law, provided he offers equal sustenance and equal treatment to all?
items.gold: A Muslim male may have four wives.
items.fact: UAE law allows a Muslim man up to four wives.
